content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments refer to the use of the Solana blockchain to facilitate transactions for digital products. This matters because it allows creators in countries where traditional payment processors are inaccessible to sell their products directly to consumers without significant fees. Unlike platforms that charge upwards of 10% per transaction, Solana transactions can cost as little as $0.10, dramatically increasing a creator's profit margins. Creators can now sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more without the burden of high fees imposed by services like Gumroad or Stripe.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for using Solana payments is built on several key components. First, creators can host their digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, which offer robust hosting solutions for free. Next, they implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions and product delivery. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which integrates seamlessly with Solana to validate transactions on-chain. This architecture ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their data and products, avoiding vendor lock-in and subscription fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where traditional payment processors have either limited functionality or are completely unavailable. It's designed for those who produce digital goods such as ebooks, courses, and templates but need a reliable way to monetize their work without incurring high fees. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can tap into global markets, accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, and enjoy greater financial sovereignty. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything needed to deploy this system, making it accessible for anyone willing to invest in their digital commerce future.
Solana payments can cut transaction fees down to as little as 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include hosting services (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), storage solutions (Supabase or Google Sheets), and file delivery systems (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). Each component works in tandem to ensure a seamless experience for both creators and consumers. Payment processing is the final piece, managed by NOWPayments, which automatically verifies and processes transactions on the Solana blockchain. Together, these components create a robust system that empowers creators to sell their digital products efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying Solana payments for your digital products, follow these steps: First, choose a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare for your product site. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Then, select a storage solution such as Supabase to keep track of your product data. Integrate NOWPayments for efficient cryptocurrency transaction processing. Finally, test your setup thoroughly before launching to ensure a smooth customer experience. For additional resources, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate product delivery seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks without using PayPal, Stripe, or Gumroad, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all the tools and templates needed to establish your own sovereign digital commerce stack, making it easier to navigate the complexities of online sales without conventional platform restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook by using the Solana blockchain along with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This allows you to bypass traditional payment processors and avoid high fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to create your own digital commerce infrastructure using hosting like GitHub Pages, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments for payment processing, which charges only 0.5%.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by utilizing Solana payments and a custom hosting solution, you can sell templates and fonts directly to consumers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a fee of only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than many traditional payment platforms, allowing you to retain more revenue from your sales.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?
Yes, you can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to ensure that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
